newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices hold steady on hot temperatures.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices hold steady on hot temperatures.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) held steady at relatively lofty levels Tuesday on continued air conditioning demand from heat in the state, industry sources said.
Next-day ERCOT power for a 16-hour on-peak block was discussed steady in the $20.00-21.00 range, sources said.
Hourly power was talked near $24.50, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak power for Wednesday delivery was talked in the $13.00-15.00 range, the sources said.

For the remainder of September, on-peak electricity was assessed in the $20.25-20.50 range, while October peak electricity was pegged up slightly in the $18.25-18.75 range from $18.00-18.50 on Monday, the sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
